title.narrative: Upper Secondary Education Sector Development Program

description.narrative: The program is the response of the Asian Development Bank (ADB) to the government's vision of improving the quality of its human resources to sustain Cambodia's economic development and enhance its competitiveness. This will be achieved by supporting sequenced reforms aimed at improving the effectiveness of upper secondary education (USE). The program will (i) support initiatives to improve access to, quality of, and relevance of USE; and (ii) strengthen institutional capacity for planning, management, and delivery of education. While the policy reforms will be applied nationwide, most of the project activities will be implemented in seven disadvantaged provinces.

description.narrative: Effectiveness of the USE system improved

GER for USE increased to 30% (female: 30%); (SY2015/16 baseline: 25.1%, female: 26.0%) Achievement: 39.3%, F=43.6% Progress/Status: Achieved.
As of June 2022 (closing date):
a. 2021/22: GER for USE is 39.3% (female: 43.5%). The GER increased by 14.2 percentage points (from 25.1% to 39.3%); Female GER increased by 17.5 percentage point (from 26.0% to 43.5%). Data Source: EMIS Baseline value: 25.1%; 26% female

Promotion rate from grade 10 to 11 increased to at least 90% (female: 90%) (SY2014/15 baseline: 82.2%, female: 83.2%) Achievement: 86.5%, F=86.8% Progress/Status: Not achieved.
As of June 2022: b. 2020/21: Promotion rate from grade 10 to grade 11 is 86.5% (female: 86.8%). The promotion rate from grade 10 to 11 increased by 4.2 percentage points (from 82.2% to 86.5%). Despite remarkable increases for both male and female, they remain lower than the project target of 90% (90% for female). Promotion rate from grade 11 to 12 increased to at least 90% (female: 90%) (SY2014/15 baseline: 88.8%, female: 89.0%) Achievement: 91.6%, F=91.0% Progress/Status: Achieved.
